payload.title: Read the audit export limit from config
payload.goal: Move the hard-coded audit export limit in src/lib/audit.ts into configuration: add auditExportLimit to loadConfig() in src/config.ts, read from the environment with the current value as the default, and pass it to AuditLog when createDeps builds it in src/app.ts. Add tests in test/config.test.ts and test/audit.test.ts.
acceptance: The export limit comes from config with today's value as the default
A small configured limit makes the CSV export keep only that many rows
No limit constant is left in a route or in the audit library
The suite stays green with new tests for the config value and the cap

payload.text:
The implementation from the previous run was already complete; I verified it and ran the suite (29/29 green).

decision: AuditLog takes a required exportLimit constructor arg with no fallback default, so the single default of 5000 lives in loadConfig().
decision: tests: test/config.test.ts changed because the task goal requires adding config-value tests there.
decision: tests: test/audit.test.ts changed because the task goal requires adding CSV-cap tests there.

What was done (verified, no new edits needed):
- `src/config.ts`: added `auditExportLimit` to `Config`, read from `AUDIT_EXPORT_LIMIT` with default 5000 via the existing `positiveInt` helper.
- `src/lib/audit.ts`: removed the hard-coded `EXPORT_LIMIT` constant; `AuditLog` now takes `exportLimit` in its constructor and `toCsv()` slices with `this.exportLimit`.
- `src/app.ts`: `createDeps` builds the log as `new AuditLog(config.auditExportLimit)`.
- `test/config.test.ts`: updated the two equality tests and added a case covering the default (5000), a set value, and the non-numeric fallback.
- `test/audit.test.ts`: added a case with `auditExportLimit: 2` posting 3 webhooks and asserting the CSV keeps only the 2 newest rows (`evt_000002`, `evt_000003`).

Verification:
- Grepped: no `EXPORT_LIMIT` remains outside config/tests, and `new AuditLog` appears only in `src/app.ts` with the config value.
- Ran `bun run test`: 6 files, 29 tests, all passing.

What I did not finish: nothing - all acceptance items are met.

What I did not look at: `src/lib/store.ts`, `src/lib/tenants.ts`, webhook/event/admin routes and their tests, and any docs or policy files; I only re-read the five files relevant to this task plus a grep and the test run.
